title: SolarCast Alert Event Schema
description: Schema definition for SolarCast Mode F1 solar energy alert events: residual deviations, input feature drift, model performance degradation, and weather data quality.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for the alert event

model_name.description: Name of the forecasting model producing predictions or evaluated

model_version.description: Version or tag of the forecasting model

window_start_utc.description: UTC timestamp of the start of the evaluation window or anomalous episode

window_end_utc.description: UTC timestamp of the end of the evaluation window or anomalous episode

reason.description: Human-readable description of the alert trigger rationale

created_at_utc.description: Timestamp when the alert event record was generated

direction.description: Direction of residual deviation relative to expectation (negative for underproduction, positive for overproduction)

bin.description: Operating condition bin evaluated for residual deviation

consecutive_hours.description: Number of consecutive hourly intervals outside calibrated bounds

mean_residual_kwh.description: Mean residual (actual - forecast) in kWh across anomalous hours in the episode

bound_low.description: Calibrated 1st percentile lower bound in kWh for the operating bin

bound_high.description: Calibrated 99th percentile upper bound in kWh for the operating bin

confirmation_issue_time_utc.description: Issue time of the second contiguous breach; not the label arrival time

target_interval_start_utc.description: Start of the confirming second breach target interval

target_interval_end_utc.description: End of the confirming second breach target interval

actual_available_at_utc.description: Supplied availability of the second label; null when not recorded

triggered_at_utc.description: Earliest confirmation after both labels arrived; null if either availability is unknown

detection_delay_hours.description: Label-based trigger minus first anomalous target start; null without availability evidence

drift_details.description: Detailed payload for input_drift alert events

performance_details.description: Detailed payload for performance_degradation alert events

quality_details.description: Detailed payload for data_quality alert events
